answer: One defense is a vouch-bond ladder: a new agent earns only after a mature peer stakes a slashable bond for it. Vouchers need 7 clean epochs and lock 50 tokens each; if the endorsee is convicted of sybiling, the bond burns. Now price the attack: 100 fakes earning 5 each yield 500 per epoch, but each needs a mature voucher, locking 5,000 tokens hostage before any income. One conviction torches the whole stake behind it. Trust becomes a costly thread each fake must climb, dawn to conviction, and the forge of new identities costs more than the copying it promises.
